item.title: CryptoNotch 1.2.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.2.0

  • Multi-Exchange Support: Added live market data ingestion and real-time WebSocket feeds for Coinbase and Kraken alongside Binance.
  • Full Order Book Depth: Implemented Level 2 depth ingestion across all three platforms, calculating top 20 bid depth, ask depth, and order book imbalance percentage.
  • Rolling Price Changes & VWAP: Added 1-hour and 4-hour rolling price changes, plus 24-hour VWAP synthesis for Coinbase.
  • Dynamic Slot Adaptation: Automatically defaults any unsupported slot metrics when switching exchanges to prevent missing or invalid data.
  • Exchange-Aware Customization: Stats grid editor now dynamically filters available metrics to match the selected exchange.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.2
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.2

  • Permissionless Global Hotkey: Replaced legacy event monitoring with native Carbon hotkey registration, enabling instant system-wide toggling without requiring macOS Accessibility permissions.
  • Updated Default Shortcut: Changed shortcut to Option + Shift + C (⌥⇧C) for effortless one-handed ergonomics and conflict-free operation with window managers.
  • Status Menu Badge: Added visual ⌥⇧C badge to the companion status menu.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.1
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.1

  • Refined Menu Bar Layout: Reorganized companion status menu to group app management actions ("Check for Updates..." and "Quit") at the bottom below feature controls, matching macOS HIG standards.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.0

  • Reorderable Favorites: Organize pinned favorite coins via smooth drag-and-drop in the switch pair popover.
  • Streaming Performance: Cached number formatters eliminating heap churn on high-frequency ticker updates.
  • Optimized Network Pipeline: Deduplicated WebSocket events and ephemeral REST snapshots.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.0.1
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.0.1

  • In-App Updates: Integrated Sparkle 2 auto-update framework for seamless DMG updates.
  • Status Bar Companion: Added "Check for Updates..." directly in the menu bar companion menu.
  • Performance & Stability: Polished notch animations, improved memory footprint, and hardened notarization pipeline.
